infoFlyoutContents.infoText: The standard range of power transmission gearboxes covers 3 series. All gearboxes are characterized by their robust, leakproof design and their quiet running. With a motor adapter standard motors and stainless steel motors in accordance with IEC and NEMA-C can be attached.

The different inline, offset and right-angle gearboxes from STOBER provide highly versatile adaptability for a wide range of servo tasks.  The motor attachment system enables attachment to all common synchronous servo motors on the market. As an option, the gearboxes can be equipped with a ServoStop motor adapter with integrated brake.

STOBER brings an entirely new generation to the market with the planetary gearbox design—high-performance, extremely precise, reliable and exceptional thanks to their highly versatile adaptability for a wide range of servo tasks.

The STOBER servo gearboxes can be equipped with a ServoStop motor adapter with integrated brake. The brake reliably prevents unintentional lowering of axes under the action of gravity, even with motor removed. Can be attached to all common synchronous servo motors with plug-in coupling.

Innovative system concept for rack and pinion gearboxes in machine tool, automation and robotics application areas.  The ZTRS design is a special engineering highlight. The bolted supporting bearing holder makes it possible to use the full gear torque in a rack and pinion gearbox for the first time and, as a result, also optimizes the volume performance and rigidity. The new ZV gearboxes are primarily designed for rack and pinion systems in automation and robotics.

STOBER brings an entirely new generation on the market with the planetary gearbox design—high-performance, extremely precise, reliable and exceptional thanks to its highly versatile adaptability.

Precision gear racks in lengths of 0.5 m and 1 m with double the number of holes for increased contact pressure and in lengths of 2 m for long travel paths with minimal impact points. All variants can be freely combined, optionally pinned and perfectly matched to STOBER pinions and gearboxes – for maximum assembly efficiency and precise, reliable transmission of the feed force.

Angle that the output shaft can be rotated when the input shaft is blocked at a torque of 0 Nm. Purely theoretical value, because a torque must be applied for the movement of the gearbox parts to overcome the friction. Therefore approximately 1 to 3% of the gearbox's nominal torque is applied inversely for measuring at the output when the input shaft is fixed in place. Results from the tooth and bearing clearance and is indicated in angular minutes based on the output.
